question.:question/problem:
Find the antiderivative of
$2\sqrt[5]{x^{4}}-3x^{3}+\frac{4}{x^{4}}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}& \int\left(2\sqrt[5]{x^{4}}-3x^{3}+\frac{4}{x^{4}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(2x^{\frac{4}{5}}-3x^{3}+4x^{-4}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 2\int x^{\frac{4}{5}}\,\mathrm{d}x-3\int x^{3}\,\mathrm{d}x+4\int x^{-4}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 2\left(\frac{x^{\frac{4}{5}+1}}{(\frac{4}{5}+1)}\right)-3\left(\frac{x^{3+1}}{(3+1)}\right)\\ &\quad +4\left(\frac{x^{-4+1}}{(-4+1)}\right)+C\\ &= \frac{10\sqrt[5]{x^{9}}}{9}-\frac{3x^{4}}{4}-\frac{4}{3x^{3}}+C.\end{aligned}
$$

\begin{aligned}& \int\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt[3]{x^{4}}}-3x^{3}+\frac{4}{x^{4}}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= \int\left(2x^{\frac{-4}{3}}-3x^{3}+4x^{-4}\right)\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 2\int x^{\frac{-4}{3}}\,\mathrm{d}x-3\int x^{3}\,\mathrm{d}x+4\int x^{-4}\,\mathrm{d}x\\ &= 2\left(\frac{x^{\frac{-4}{3}+1}}{(\frac{-4}{3}+1)}\right)-3\left(\frac{x^{3+1}}{(3+1)}\right)\\ &\quad +4\left(\frac{x^{-4+1}}{(-4+1)}\right)+C\\ &= -\frac{6}{\sqrt[3]{x}}-\frac{3x^{4}}{4}-\frac{4}{3x^{3}}+C.\end{aligned}
$$
